entries.name: screenpipe
entries.reason: Source-available commercial license; not OSI open source.
entries.useful_lesson: Ambient screen/audio capture, local search, and per-pipeline permissions.

entries.name: AFFiNE
entries.reason: Mixed repository: community/client portions are open, but backend enterprise code has production restrictions.
entries.useful_lesson: Integrated document, database, and whiteboard workspace UX.

entries.name: Onyx
entries.reason: Open-core repository containing enterprise-licensed directories; excluded by strict all-code-open default.

entries.name: OpenHands
entries.reason: Mixed repository: the core is MIT, while enterprise code is source-available under commercial terms.
entries.useful_lesson: Sandboxed coding-agent execution, event streams, and delegation architecture.

entries.name: Obsidian
entries.useful_lesson: Local Markdown ecosystem and plugin-driven PKM.

entries.name: Microsoft Recall
entries.useful_lesson: OS-level ambient recall and the associated privacy threat model.

entries.name: WrenAI
entries.reason: Mixed-license repository with an explicit path-based license map; excluded by the strict single-scope catalog rule.
entries.useful_lesson: Governed semantic context, query validation, and text-to-SQL across heterogeneous data sources.

entries.name: LangSmith
entries.reason: The public MIT repository contains client SDKs, while the LangSmith platform is commercial and self-hosting requires an Enterprise license.
entries.useful_lesson: Agent tracing, evaluation, production observability, and recovery-oriented operations.

entries.name: Mastra
entries.reason: Mixed open-core repository: most code is Apache-2.0, while ee/ directories prohibit production use without a commercial agreement.
entries.useful_lesson: TypeScript-first agent workflows, evaluation, observability, and deployment ergonomics.

entries.name: Claude Agent SDK for TypeScript
entries.reason: The repository LICENSE.md reserves all rights and makes use subject to Anthropic's commercial terms; it is not OSI open source.
entries.useful_lesson: Provider-native agent SDK design, typed tool interfaces, hooks, permissions, and session management.
